sourceReferences.finding: Trinkets may be used when the situation applies; the hero declares use, resolves the effect, flips the card, and in battle may use a Trinket only once per turn. The Critical Stone example leaves its negative use at an unspecified 'at some point'.
Exploration, Resting, Hero Turns, and Hamlet procedures were checked and do not define voluntary Trinket declaration insertion points.
Card wording identifies declaration-driven effects but does not close the cross-context timing domain.

runtimeDecision.reason: No reliable source defines a complete legal timing domain, so the engine does not infer one from its current phases or UI.
